subject: Minute-level burst top-up request & true-up plan
content:
From: Samir Patel <samir@clearlane.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: minute-level top-up during conversion test

Hi Tessa,

We start a 48-hour conversion test next week and expect a short, sharp spike across a handful of endpoints. Our infra team needs the ability to raise the throughput ceiling by minute increments (not just daily quotas) to avoid dropped requests in the test window.

Can Redwood support a minute-resolution burst top-up for ~72 hours? If so, please outline the pricing (surcharge vs blended rate), whether there's a PO/AMendment path, and any discounts for committing to switch 25% of monthly usage to Redwood after the test. We need to align on true-up mechanics too — we can't prepay entire capacity.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, ClearLane

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clearlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: minute-level top-up during conversion test

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads-up. Short answer: yes, we can. Longer answer below with options and next steps. Attaching a recent usage snapshot so you can see estimated headroom needs.

Options we can offer for a 72-hour, minute-resolution uplift:

1) Ephemeral top-up (fastest, no commit)
   - Per-minute capacity added on-demand, billed at list surge rate (1.5x standard token rate).
   - No contractual amendment required; we'll apply as a usage surcharge and reconcile on next invoice.

2) Blended short-term uplift (recommended)
   - Temporary blended rate for the 72-hour window: standard token rate + 25% uplift.
   - Requires a short amendment (attached draft) and PO — we can fast-track to 48-hour signature.
   - Includes a 10% conversion discount on base monthly usage if ClearLane converts 25% of monthly traffic to Redwood within 30 days.

3) Commit-conversion credit (preferred for discounts)
   - If you commit to a 3-month minimum baseline increase we can provide a 20% discounted uplift rate for the test window + convert-credit to apply retroactively to the first invoice after conversion.

True-up mechanics
- We invoice the uplift as an estimated charge for the window and then reconcile actuals at month-end (standard true-up). Any over-estimate will be credit-applied; under-estimate will generate a reconciliation charge.

Next steps
- Tell me which option you prefer. If 2 or 3, we need a PO and a quick signed amendment (I attached draft_amendment_v2.pdf). If 1, we'll enable a minute-level top-up flag and send a confirmation email with the live usage link.

Cc'ing Ben & Markus for pricing approval and any finance notes.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: minute-level top-up during conversion test

Tessa — adding the numbers here so we can be specific. I modeled two scenarios using the attached usage snapshot.

Assumptions:
- Baseline token rate: $0.0008 / token (standard)
- Expected spike: up to 1M tokens/min for 2 hours, then tapering over 70 hours to ~200k tokens/min
- Total incremental tokens over window: ~1.2B tokens

Pricing proposals:
A) Ephemeral surcharge (no contract)
   - 1.5x list: $0.0012 / token on incremental usage -> est. uplift = $1,440,000
B) Blended uplift (72-hr amendment)
   - Standard + 25% uplift: $0.0010 / token -> est. uplift = $1,200,000
   - If ClearLane signs a 3-month trial baseline commit we can offer a 20% discount on the uplift portion -> $0.0008 / token -> est. uplift = $960,000

Operational notes:
- Minute-level enablement is straightforward: toggle flag + automated rate-limiter rules.
- For blended/commit options: legal needs the signed amendment, finance needs a PO with estimated amt and net-30. We can invoice estimated and true-up.

My recommendation: go with option B + 3-month commit credit if they’re willing. It gives them price predictability and saves them ~480k compared to surge surcharge in the example.

Ben
Sr. Solutions, Redwood Inference

---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Quick: minute-level top-up during conversion test

Ben — agree with your math. Authorize a negotiated uplift: we can offer option B with a 20% discount on the uplift portion if the customer signs a 90-day trial baseline (agree to minimum monthly commit).

Two caveats:
- If actuals exceed the forecast by >35% we'll apply an overrun surcharge at 1.25x uplift rate for the overage portion.
- We need procurement PO to initiate amendment. Legal to circulate the amendment and finance to record estimated invoice for net-30.

Markus
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clearlane.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlane.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: minute-level top-up during conversion test

Samir — based on internal approval, here is the proposed path we can execute quickly:

- Plan: Blended short-term uplift (Option B) for the 72-hour window starting 2028-05-21 00:00 UTC.
- Rate: standard + 20% uplift on the uplifted volume (you'll see lower line items due to the 20% concession tied to a 90-day trial baseline commit).
- True-up: estimated invoice after the window, reconcile at month-end. Overruns >35% incur a 1.25x surcharge on the excess.
- Paperwork: Please supply a PO to procurement@redwood.ai for the estimated uplift ($960,000 est) and sign the attached amendment (draft_amendment_v2.pdf).
- Operational: we'll enable minute-resolution burst gating and provide a live dashboard link during the window.

Attachments: usage_snapshot_May2028.csv, draft_amendment_v2.pdf

If procurement wants a smaller estimated amt on the PO we can accept a conservative estimate and true-up more frequently — open to discussing.

Next step: Samir, can you loop in your procurement contact and confirm PO cadence? If you approve the start time above we'll queue legal to issue a DocuSign.

Thanks,
Tessa
